name: npc_sohei-guard-01
customDialogue: The gate stays open. The Sohei hide from nothing.

name: npc_sohei-villager-01
customDialogue:
The bells woke me twice last night.
There was no wind at all.

name: npc_sohei-monk-01
customDialogue:
I tie prayer threads between the lanterns.
They keep the hands steady when the ground is not.

name: npc_sohei-trainee-01
customDialogue:
Balance first. Then strength.
The tremors are teaching us both.

name: npc_sohei-bellkeeper-01
customDialogue:
Every bell here has its own voice.
Lately they all say the same thing.

spotConfig.label: Listen to the bell
spotConfig.text: The gate bell trembles without a sound you can hear. Your teeth feel it more than your ears.

spotConfig.label: Listen to the bell
spotConfig.text: The library bell hums low, in time with something far below.

spotConfig.label: Listen to the bell
spotConfig.text: The hall bell is the loudest. It leans toward the Hub, though no wind blows.

spotConfig.label: Feel the air
spotConfig.text: Cold air rises between the stones at the edge of the pond. It smells of deep earth.

spotConfig.label: Feel the air
spotConfig.text: Between the raked stones a crack breathes out cold, damp air.

spotConfig.label: Hold up the prayer ribbon
spotConfig.text: The ribbon streams away from the vents, down the mountain, toward the Hub. The tunnels breathe in here and out there.

spotConfig.label: Tie the prayer thread
spotConfig.text: You tie the thread to the lantern by the dojo stairs. It hangs perfectly still.

spotConfig.label: Tie the prayer thread
spotConfig.text: The thread on the pond lantern lifts in the cold air from the vent, then settles.

spotConfig.label: Tie the prayer thread
spotConfig.text: You tie the last thread in the zen garden. Three lanterns, one thread.

spotConfig.label: Ring the great bell three times

requires.hint: The great bell waits for the evening.

spotConfig.text: Three slow notes roll down the mountain. Far below, a fourth note answers.

spotConfig.label: Count the stones
spotConfig.text: Fifteen stones lie in the raked gravel, but from any one place you can only ever see fourteen. One always hides.
The sun comes up over the hills and lights the great bell before anything else. For a moment it glows like a second sun.
The storm tears the maple leaves loose. For a moment they hang in the air in the shape of a bell.

spotConfig.label: Look behind the shop
spotConfig.text: Tucked behind the shop's back post: a folded prayer slip. It asks the bells to stay quiet, just for one night.

spotConfig.label: Look closer
spotConfig.text: A tiny ant peeks out at you.
